mapper.sql: id AS "id", slug AS "slug", title AS "title", category AS "category", summary AS "summary", cover_image AS "coverImage", status AS "status", to_char(published_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "publishedAt"
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM blog_post WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND category = #{category}

SELECT , body AS "body", cover_alt AS "coverAlt", cover_caption AS "coverCaption", cover_prompt AS "coverPrompt", hashtags AS "hashtags", sources AS "sources" FROM blog_post WHERE slug = #{slug} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
SELECT , to_char(updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "updatedAt" FROM blog_post WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY published_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT , body AS "body", cover_alt AS "coverAlt", cover_caption AS "coverCaption", cover_prompt AS "coverPrompt", hashtags AS "hashtags", sources AS "sources" FROM blog_post WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_post (slug, title, category, summary, body, cover_image, cover_alt, cover_caption, cover_prompt, hashtags, sources, status, published_at) VALUES (#{slug}, #{title}, #{category}, #{summary}, #{body}, #{coverImage}, #{coverAlt}, #{coverCaption}, #{coverPrompt}, #{hashtags}, #{sources}, #{status}, CAST(#{publishedAt} AS DATE))

INSERT INTO blog_post (slug, title, category, summary, body, cover_image, cover_alt, cover_caption, cover_prompt, hashtags, sources, status, published_at) VALUES (#{slug}, #{title}, #{category}, #{summary}, #{body}, #{coverImage}, #{coverAlt}, #{coverCaption}, #{coverPrompt}, #{hashtags}, #{sources}, #{status}, CAST(#{publishedAt} AS DATE)) ON CONFLICT (slug) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE blog_post SET slug = #{slug}, title = #{title}, category = #{category}, summary = #{summary}, body = #{body}, cover_image = #{coverImage}, cover_alt = #{coverAlt}, cover_caption = #{coverCaption}, cover_prompt = #{coverPrompt}, hashtags = #{hashtags}, sources = #{sources}, status = #{status}, published_at = CAST(#{publishedAt} AS DATE), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE blog_post SET deleted_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
